title: Archive the Onboarding
subtitle: Retain the run and seed the loop
scenario: It is the start date, 8:30 AM - the hire is in. Close the run by archiving it: retain the package and tracker for audit, and mark that it seeds the catalog loop. Yesterday's archive is what teaches tomorrow's role profile.
input: Onboarding for hire H-4021 is complete and acknowledged. Archive it under the run id onboarding-H-4021 with a 7-year retention. Mark that it seeds the catalog: what this role actually needed feeds the profile-feedback loop.
instructions: Record the hire id and the archived run id.
Mark that the archive seeds the catalog (seedsCatalog).
Return one valid JSON object, then validate.
copilotPrompt: Build one JSON archive record: hireId, archivedRun, retention, and seedsCatalog (boolean). Retain onboarding-H-4021 for 7 years and mark that it seeds the catalog.
successMessage: Onboarding archived. It is retained for audit and marked to seed the catalog loop.
editorHelper: Retain the run - and mark that it feeds tomorrow's profile.

intro.heading: Close the run: retain and seed

sections.title: Retention is a compliance decision
sections.body: Completed onboardings are kept for a defined period - here 7 years - so an auditor can reconstruct who got what and when. The retention length is a governed choice, not an afterthought.

sections.title: The archive is a loop input
sections.body: This archive is not a dead end. It feeds the profile-feedback step: what this hire actually needed becomes a proposal to improve the role catalog. Yesterday's run teaches tomorrow's profile.

sections.title: A stable identity
sections.body: The run is archived under a stable id (onboarding-H-4021) so it can be found again. A weak id makes the archive unsearchable and the loop impossible.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: An archive record that both satisfies retention and opens the temporal loop back to the role profile catalog.

takeaway.heading: Onboarding archived
points: You retained the completed run for 7 years under a stable id.
The archive is marked to seed the catalog - it is a loop input, not a dead end.
A stable run id keeps the archive searchable for audit and feedback.
The run is closed and ready to teach the next hire's profile.
The workflow can now retain each onboarding and feed it back to the catalog.
